text: Paper · Preprint · arXiv 2609.02749 Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills Jianlyu Chen, Yuyang Hu, Hongjin Qian, Jiawei Liu, Wenqing Wei, Xiaolong Chen, Defu Lian, Zhicheng Dou, Chaozhuo Li, Qiwei Ye, Zheng Liu Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI), University of Science and Technology of China, Renmin University of China, Hong Kong Polytechnic University (corresponding authors Defu Lian, Zhicheng Dou, Zheng Liu) · September 2026 (arXiv v1, 2 September 2026; the only version so far) In one line: Names the thing agent skills usually lack, operational knowledge (the practical know-how of getting a published method to actually run, which lives in READMEs and issues rather than papers), and distils it out of repositories into reusable skills both task-agnostically and task-oriented; the AREX-Skill Library is 5,000+ verified skills from 1,000 ML repos across 20 areas and 178 capability families, and on a GPT-5.5 backbone at fixed compute it buys +134.3% on MLE-bench, +34.4% PaperBench, +9.2% FrontierCS, +14.0% PassNet.
